audit_result.proof_trace: The sole token comparison at L30 uses JavaScript's `!==` operator (`if (token !== validToken)`), which short-circuits at the first differing byte and is not constant-time. No `crypto.timingSafeEqual` or equivalent is used anywhere in the codebase, and there is no rate limiting. The proof fails at this line — no constant-time guard exists.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker sends repeated HTTP requests to any authenticated endpoint (e.g., `POST /api/roles/sync`) with candidate token prefixes, statistically measuring response latency to identify correct bytes one at a time, eventually reconstructing `API_AUTH_TOKEN` and gaining full API access.

PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-001.text: Token comparison must use constant-time algorithm to prevent timing side-channel extraction.
PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-001.assertion: forall req: auth_compare(req.token, valid_token) uses timing_safe_equal, not ===
